state.seed_assertion: A DPIA must involve the opinion of the Data Protection Officer and, where appropriate, the point of view of data subjects or their representatives.

sentences.1: A DPIA must involve the opinion of the Data Protection Officer and, where appropriate, the point of view of data subjects or their representatives.
sentences.2: Interested parties are involved: The opinion of the DPO is obtained (article 35, paragraph 2);
sentences.3: The point of view of the data subjects or their representatives are gathered, where appropriate (article 35, paragraph 9).
sentences.4: Controllers should seek views of data subjects or their representatives on intended processing when appropriate, without prejudice to protection of commercial interests, public interests or security of operations.
sentences.5: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.6: The controller should seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing when appropriate, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.7: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.8: Consultation with data protection officers and where appropriate with individuals and relevant experts is a requirement in the DPIA process.
sentences.9: The advice and recommendations of the DPO should be recorded in a DPIA where relevant and the DPIA should be signed off by appropriate people.
sentences.10: Controllers must provide the Commissioner with specific information when consulting about high-risk processing, including responsibilities of parties involved, processing purposes and means, protective measures, data protection officer contact details, and the DPIA itself.
